claim_text: Virgin Plus says an unknown party got into an internal system
summary: Virgin Plus's own notice says an unknown party gained unauthorized access to an internal system holding customer personal information on Nov 17, 2026.
detail: The notice is on the company's own support site. It says Virgin Plus removed the threat actor on discovery, started emergency protocols and is monitoring its systems. The notice carries no publication date.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's notice says in its own words that an unknown party gained unauthorized access.

claim_text: The data may include contact details and account details
summary: Virgin Plus says the data may include name, mailing address, phone number, email address, account number, product information and the date and amount of the last payment.
detail: The notice says 'may have included', so it does not say each customer lost every item.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notice lists these data types.

claim_text: Virgin Plus says no card or bank details were affected
summary: Virgin Plus says it confirmed that no highly sensitive information, such as a credit card number or bank account information, was affected.
detail: This is the company's own finding, with no outside check.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The company states it; no independent source has checked it.
notes: Company claim, counted as one source.

claim_text: Virgin Plus says it removed the intruder and has been telling customers
summary: Virgin Plus says it removed the threat actor on discovery and began informing customers once it confirmed some data may have been affected.
detail: The notice does not say when notices went out, how they were sent, or when the intruder was removed.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The company states it; no outside source confirms it.

claim_text: Virgin Plus has called in the RCMP's cybercrime unit
summary: Virgin Plus says it has engaged the RCMP's cybercrime unit to investigate, and will advise other regulators as required.
detail: No police or regulator statement was found. This rests on the company's notice.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The company says it engaged the RCMP; no RCMP statement was found.

claim_text: Virgin Plus is a Bell brand
summary: CBC News reported in 2025 that Virgin Plus is owned by Bell.
detail: Context only: the 2025 story is about a number transfer, not this incident.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CBC states Virgin Plus is owned by Bell.

summary: No count has been published by Virgin Plus or any outlet we found.
detail: The notice says only that certain customer information was involved.
label: Not established

summary: The notice does not say how the unknown party got in or what kind of attack it was.
detail: Whether data was copied, not only viewed, is also not stated. The notice says information 'may have' been affected.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The notice gives no method or detail.

summary: No source names the attacker, and no group has claimed it in the sources we read.
detail: We did not look at leak sites, forums or trackers.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The notice calls the attacker 'an unknown party'.

claim_text: Bell Canada says an 'agentic' attacker stole enterprise customer data on Nov 17
summary: Bell told CBC and BleepingComputer that a threat actor accessed some Bell systems on Nov 17 and took some enterprise customer data. Bell says it does not know who did it.
detail: This is a business-customer incident with its own system. It is covered here as context only.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Two independent outlets report Bell's statement.

claim_text: The Virgin Plus breach is connected to Bell's Nov 17 breach
summary: Both happened on Nov 17 and Virgin Plus is a Bell brand. No official or independent source says they are the same attack.
detail: The Virgin Plus notice does not mention Bell Canada's incident, and Bell's statements do not mention Virgin Plus. A shared date is not evidence of a link.
label: Unverified
why_it_supports: No source connects the two incidents.
